Inscribed with a white rectangular seal of "Wang Sun of the Eastern Sea".　　The 28th year refers to the 28th year of the Republic of China (1939), when Xu Beihong was 44 years old.　　The picture depicts a rooster strolling with its feet up in the lower part of the center of the painting, against which are two tall and robust sunflowers.
